prompt:
Use the attached screenshot as the PRIMARY visual reference. Generate a faithful high-fidelity flat mobile UI mockup for Palla's organizer session occurrence detail. The previous design was rejected because it did not resemble this reference. Your task is faithful reproduction of its layout, not a redesign. Show ONE continuous tall scrolling screen, no multi-screen board, no device frame, no dark desktop surrounding it, no browser chrome, no explanatory headings outside. Output a narrow tall high-resolution image with the same proportions as the screenshot's actual UI content pane, approximately 440 wide by 2150 tall logical pixels. All sections fit. Keep the screenshot's exact sequence, density, whitespace ratios, card nesting, rounded corners and compact rows.

Visual system: pale lavender #fbf8ff full canvas, white #ffffff major cards, lavender #f4f2fd rounded inset blocks, dark #1a1b22 Hanken Grotesk-like sans typography, fluorescent lime #d4ff00 pills and primary actions, olive #536600 details, very subtle thin borders. Main cards 24px radius, roster rows 16px, inset blocks 16px. Screen margins20px, generous16-20px interior padding. Crisp thin outline icons, small circular photographic player portraits. Reference screenshot is a visual layout/style reference, not an edit target. Preserve its appearance very closely. No flattening into divider-only rows, no oversized page title, no generic redesign, no additional series/rules cards.

TOP: compact header chevron left, 'Session #242' bold, edit outline and QR icon buttons right.
SUMMARY white rounded card:
top compact lavender pill repeat icon 'Weekly · Next: Oct 31', and lime pill '3/4 Filled' right.
Bold heading 'Main Court · Sunset AC'.
Compact calendar 'Sat, Oct 24' and clock '18:00–19:30 (90m)' line.
Two lavender metric cards side by side exactly like reference: left small 'Categories', bold '6ta–7ma'; right small 'Per player', bold '$12,000', tiny 'ARS' with a tiny olive 'At club' label.
Below lavender inset full-width registration row with lime circular person icon left, 'Accepting registrations' bold and 'Visible to players' small below; lime ON toggle right.
ACTIVE ROSTER outside summary card: bold 'Active Roster', small '4-player doubles session' below, small neutral count pill '3 players' right.
Three compact separate white rounded row cards:
photo Alex Rivera, tiny '6ta' tag, olive 'Confirmed' subtitle, lime 'Confirmed' badge at far right.
photo Carlos M., tiny '7ma' tag, olive 'Confirmed' subtitle, chat icon and dots at right.
photo Elena G., tiny '6ta' tag, olive 'Confirmed' subtitle, chat icon and dots at right.
Fourth dashed rounded vacant slot card matching screenshot: pale circular add-person icon, 'Slot 4: Available' bold, 'Invite a player or promote from waitlist' tiny grey text; small dark '+ Invite Directly' button aligned right below.
WAITLIST QUEUE white rounded major card matching screenshot: heading 'Waitlist Queue' with tiny count2 pill, 'First-in, first-out' muted aligned right.
Lavender inset queue block with photo Sofia T., tiny '6ta' badge, 'Joined 2h ago' small, X right. Full-width lime button trophy/person icon 'Promote to Match'.
Second lavender queue row photo David K., tiny '7ma', small 'Joined 30m ago', little '#2 in queue' muted badge on right.
Lavender info inset underneath lightning icon with 'Manual promotion' bold and small 'Choose a waiting player to fill the available court slot.' This preserves reference note size/layout.
COURT CHECK-IN white rounded major card exactly like reference: heading 'Court Check-in', small 'Verify on-court arrivals', lavender small 'Scan Pass' action right. Host row olive dot 'Alex Rivera' and olive check 'Arrived (17:45)'. Second row grey dot 'Carlos M.' with lavender 'Tap to Check In' small button right. Third row grey dot 'Elena G.' with matching button.
BOTTOM exactly same arrangement as screenshot: full width dark rounded 'Broadcast Message to Players' button with megaphone icon. Full width red thin outlined rounded 'Cancel Session' button with circled X. Tiny grey footer 'Free cancellation up to 6 hours before match start.'
This is a visual concept; player roster/waitlist/check-in/messaging are proposed UI. Do not add implementation disclaimers inside screen. Do not add Palla Pay, paid badges, decimal ratings, reliability percentages or refund promises. Only those product text adaptations; all shapes/composition/relative card sizes should closely match attached reference. All text legible and accurately spelled.
scope: Reference-faithful visual concept; no app code changes

approval.source: User: okey, let’s apply this design system and build the session occurrence detail screen, including placeholders
